_comment: State law overlay tables. Empty/RESEARCH-REQUIRED fields fail closed — the engine refuses to run a property whose state entry is incomplete. Ratified entries: MD, MO (2026-08-03).

MD.ueta: the federal ESIGN Act and the Maryland Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (Md. Code Ann., Commercial Law, Title 21).
MD.possession_statutes: summary ejectment proceedings under Md. Code Ann., Real Property §8-401 and breach-of-lease proceedings under Md. Code Ann., Real Property §8-402.1
MD.env_overlay: the Environment Article of the Maryland Code
MD.parcel_reference: (Maryland SDAT Tax Account No. [TAX ACCOUNT NO])
MD.extra_no_recording: Notwithstanding the foregoing, if the Lease Term, together with all renewal or extension terms, exceeds seven (7) years, Landlord may prepare, execute and record a memorandum of lease in the form permitted by Md. Code Ann., Real Property §3-101(e), and Tenant shall execute, acknowledge and deliver such memorandum within ten (10) days after Landlord’s request; in no event shall a full copy of this Lease be recorded by either party.
MD.notes: Late fee/default interest: commercial freedom of contract; usury regime consumer-directed; savings clause retained regardless. §8-203 security deposit statute residential-only. Jury waiver enforceable in commercial leases (knowing and voluntary).

MO.ueta: the federal ESIGN Act and the Missouri Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (Sections 432.200 to 432.295, RSMo).
MO.possession_statutes: actions for rent and possession under Chapter 535, RSMo, and actions for unlawful detainer under Chapter 534, RSMo
MO.env_overlay: the Missouri Hazardous Waste Management Law, Chapter 260, RSMo
MO.notes: §535.300 double-damages does not reach commercial tenants (PDQ Tower Services v. Adams, Mo. App. 2007). Jury waiver: standalone conspicuous all-caps clause required (Malan Realty Investors v. Harris, 953 S.W.2d 624 (Mo. banc 1997)) — the master's format satisfies this; do not merge it into another section.
